programme.desc: Live. Renowned for his lightning-fast reflexes and unwavering courage, Shay Given is one of the Premier League's all-time greatest goalkeepers. The Irishman reflects on his most memorable moments between the posts as Newcastle's number one.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP23
programme.desc: Live. Aston Villa's 1992/93 season had all the ingredients of a defining football story. Through special behind-the-scenes footage, PL Stories takes viewers inside Ron Atkinson's Villa, revealing the characters, camaraderie and mounting pressure of a gripping title challenge. From the dressing room to the drama on the pitch, this is the inside story of Villa's pursuit of the first Premier League crown.

programme.title: GOALS OF THE SEASON - 2016/2017 (GB: KANE)
programme.desc: Live. We take a look back at some of the most spectacular and important goals from previous Premier League seasons.

programme.title: NETBUSTERS - MW10 - EP10
programme.desc: Live. A fast-paced music and commentary driven ISO angle highlights show featuring every game and every goal from each match round.

programme.title: THE ART OF... - EP1
programme.desc: Live. Peter and Kasper Schmeichel explore how the art of goalkeeping has evolved throughout the Premier League era. From the fundamentals of shot-stopping, positioning and commanding the penalty area to the modern demands of distribution and playing with the ball at your feet, the Schmeichels break down what it takes to be an elite goalkeeper. Featuring some of the Premier League's greatest number ones, the show examines how one of football's most specialised positions has been transformed.
